verses.zh: 所罗门的箴言：智慧之子使父亲欢乐；愚昧之子叫母亲担忧。
verses.kjv: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.
verses.en: The wise sayings of Solomon. A wise son makes his father glad; a foolish son makes his mother sad.

verses.zh: 不义之财毫无益处；惟有公义能救人脱离死亡。
verses.kjv: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death.
verses.en: Money got by doing wrong is no use at all, but doing right saves a person from death.

verses.zh: 耶和华不使义人受饥饿；恶人所欲的，他必推开。
verses.kjv: The LORD will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked.
verses.en: The LORD will not let a good person go hungry, but he pushes away what bad people are greedy for.

verses.zh: 手懒的，要受贫穷；手勤的，却要富足。
verses.kjv: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.
verses.en: Lazy hands make a person poor, but hard-working hands make a person rich.

verses.zh: 夏天聚敛的，是智慧之子；收割时沉睡的，是贻羞之子。
verses.kjv: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son: but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.
verses.en: Gathering crops in summer is what a wise son does; sleeping through harvest is what a shameful son does.

verses.zh: 福祉临到义人的头；强暴蒙蔽恶人的口。
verses.kjv: Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
verses.en: Blessings rest on the head of a good person, but violence covers the mouth of a bad one.

verses.zh: 义人的纪念被称赞；恶人的名字必朽烂。
verses.kjv: The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.
verses.en: People remember a good person kindly, but the name of a bad person rots away.

verses.zh: 心中智慧的，必受命令；口里愚妄的，必致倾倒。
verses.kjv: The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.
verses.en: A wise heart takes in commands, but a person who babbles foolishly will fall.

verses.zh: 行正直路的，步步安稳；走弯曲道的，必致败露。
verses.kjv: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
verses.en: Walking honestly means walking safely; walking crooked ways means being found out.

verses.zh: 以眼传神的，使人忧患；口里愚妄的，必致倾倒。
verses.kjv: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.
verses.en: Someone who winks slyly causes trouble, and a person who babbles foolishly will fall.

verses.zh: 义人的口是生命的泉源；强暴蒙蔽恶人的口。
verses.kjv: The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
verses.en: A good person's mouth is a well of life, but violence covers the mouth of a bad one.

verses.zh: 恨能挑启争端；爱能遮掩一切过错。
verses.kjv: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
verses.en: Hate stirs up quarrels, but love covers over every wrong.

verses.zh: 明哲人嘴里有智慧；无知人背上受刑杖。
verses.kjv: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.
verses.en: Wisdom is found on the lips of someone who understands, but a stick is for the back of someone with no sense.

verses.zh: 智慧人积存知识；愚妄人的口速致败坏。
verses.kjv: Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.
verses.en: Wise people store up what they know, but a fool's mouth brings ruin close.

verses.zh: 富户的财物是他的坚城；穷人的贫乏是他的败坏。
verses.kjv: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city: the destruction of the poor is their poverty.
verses.en: A rich person's money is like a strong city; being poor is what ruins the poor.

verses.zh: 义人的勤劳致生；恶人的进项致死。
verses.kjv: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.
verses.en: A good person's work leads to life; what a bad person earns leads to sin.

verses.zh: 谨守训诲的，乃在生命的道上；违弃责备的，便失迷了路。
verses.kjv: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.
verses.en: Whoever keeps to teaching is on the road of life, but whoever refuses correction gets lost.

verses.zh: 隐藏怨恨的，有说谎的嘴；口出谗谤的，是愚妄的人。
verses.kjv: He that hideth hatred with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.
verses.en: Hiding hate means lying lips, and spreading gossip makes a person a fool.

verses.zh: 多言多语难免有过；禁止嘴唇是有智慧。
verses.kjv: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips is wise.
verses.en: Too many words always bring wrongdoing; holding your tongue is wise.

verses.zh: 义人的舌乃似高银；恶人的心所值无几。
verses.kjv: The tongue of the just is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked is little worth.
verses.en: A good person's tongue is like fine silver; a bad person's heart is worth very little.

verses.zh: 义人的口教养多人；愚昧人因无知而死亡。
verses.kjv: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.
verses.en: A good person's words feed many, but fools die because they have no sense.

verses.zh: 耶和华所赐的福使人富足，并不加上忧虑。
verses.kjv: The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.
verses.en: The LORD's blessing makes a person rich, and he adds no sorrow to it.

verses.zh: 愚妄人以行恶为戏耍；明哲人却以智慧为乐。
verses.kjv: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.
verses.en: A fool thinks doing wrong is a game, but a person who understands enjoys wisdom.

verses.zh: 恶人所怕的，必临到他；义人所愿的，必蒙应允。
verses.kjv: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.
verses.en: What a bad person dreads will happen to them; what a good person wants will be given.

verses.zh: 暴风一过，恶人归于无有；义人的根基却是永久。
verses.kjv: As the whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no more: but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.
verses.en: When the storm passes, bad people are gone, but good people stand firm for ever.

verses.zh: 懒惰人叫差他的人如醋倒牙，如烟薰目。
verses.kjv: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that send him.
verses.en: Like vinegar on the teeth or smoke in the eyes, that is what a lazy person is to whoever sends him.

verses.zh: 敬畏耶和华使人日子加多；但恶人的年岁必被减少。
verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
verses.en: Respecting the LORD adds days to your life, but a bad person's years are cut short.

verses.zh: 义人的盼望必得喜乐；恶人的指望必致灭没。
verses.kjv: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.
verses.en: What good people hope for ends in joy, but what bad people expect comes to nothing.

verses.zh: 耶和华的道是正直人的保障，却成了作孽人的败坏。
verses.kjv: The way of the LORD is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
verses.en: The LORD's way is a safe place for honest people, but ruin for those who do wrong.

verses.zh: 义人永不挪移；恶人不得住在地上。
verses.kjv: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.
verses.en: Good people will never be shaken loose, but bad people will not stay in the land.

verses.zh: 义人的口滋生智慧；乖谬的舌必被割断。
verses.kjv: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.
verses.en: A good person's mouth grows wisdom, but a twisted tongue will be cut off.

verses.zh: 义人的嘴能令人喜悦；恶人的口说乖谬的话。
verses.kjv: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness.
verses.en: A good person's lips know what is fitting, but a bad person's mouth says twisted things.
